SELECT
    "name" AS event_space_name,
    "event_space",
    "capacity"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
    AND "capacity" >= 200;

SELECT
    r."name" AS establishment_name,
    CASE
        WHEN r."food_service" = 'Restaurant' THEN 'ресторан'
        WHEN r."food_service" = 'Café' THEN 'кафе'
    END AS establishment_type
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    LOWER(r."cuisine") = 'italian'
ORDER BY
    establishment_type, establishment_name;

WITH english_chefs AS (
    
    SELECT
        "name" AS chef_name,
        "language"
    FROM
        "staff"
    WHERE
        LOWER("role") = 'chef'
        AND LOWER("language") = 'english'
),

all_servers AS (
    
    SELECT
        "name" AS server_name,
        "language"
    FROM
        "staff"
    WHERE
        LOWER("role") = 'server'
),

chef_languages AS (
    
    SELECT DISTINCT
        "language"
    FROM
        english_chefs
)


SELECT
    ec.chef_name AS "Chef Name",
    ec.language AS "Chef Language",
    asrv.server_name AS "Server Name",
    asrv.language AS "Server Language"
FROM
    english_chefs ec
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        server_name,
        language
    FROM
        all_servers
    WHERE
        LOWER(all_servers.language) = LOWER(ec.language)
) asrv
ORDER BY
    ec.chef_name,
    asrv.server_name;

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    array_agg(s."system_name") AS system_names,
    array_agg(s."is_active") AS system_statuses
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
LEFT JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name";

WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total
    FROM
        "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

SELECT
    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY
    i."id";

WITH software_developer_positions AS (
    
    SELECT
        p."id" AS position_id
    FROM
        "position" p
    WHERE
        LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software%'
        OR LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%developer%'
),

hourly_rates AS (
    
    SELECT
        sd."hourly_rate"
    FROM
        "salarydetails" sd
    JOIN
        software_developer_positions sdp ON sd."positionid" = sdp.position_id
    WHERE
        sd."hourly_rate" IS NOT NULL
),

salary_ranges AS (
    
    SELECT
        
        CASE
            WHEN sd."salary_range" ~ '^\$[0-9]+k\s*-\s*\$[0-9]+k$' THEN
                (CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(sd."salary_range", '-', 1), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
                 CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(sd."salary_range", '-', 2), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS INTEGER) * 1000) / 2.0 / 2080
            ELSE NULL
        END AS calculated_hourly_rate
    FROM
        "salarydetails" sd
    JOIN
        software_developer_positions sdp ON sd."positionid" = sdp.position_id
    WHERE
        sd."hourly_rate" IS NULL
        AND sd."salary_range" IS NOT NULL
)


SELECT
    AVG(hourly_rate) AS avg_hourly_rate,
    MIN(hourly_rate) AS min_hourly_rate,
    MAX(hourly_rate) AS max_hourly_rate
FROM (
    SELECT hourly_rate FROM hourly_rates
    UNION ALL
    SELECT calculated_hourly_rate FROM salary_ranges WHERE calculated_hourly_rate IS NOT NULL
) AS combined_rates;
